items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You met Mr. Russell. I believe he was able to do Mr. Thompson. Mr. Collins. How do you do? How do you do? Please meet Mr. Thompson.

ctx.x: He's got ten years on you though. It's ten after five. This is my uncle. That's my aunt's husband.
How do you do? Good to know you. I'm Mr. Monetta, Professor Monetta, Mr. Thompson. All right, Mr. Thompson.
You met Mr. Russell. I believe he was able to do Mr. Thompson. Mr. Collins. How do you do? How do you do? Please meet Mr. Thompson.
